limitations: Community-maintained results, not an official live feed.
No pass, pressure, position or tracking event data is inferred from final scores.
Not all requested competition-seasons are available or complete in these freely redistributable sources.
UEFA regulation outcomes exclude penalty shootout scores; ambiguous extra-time/penalty records remain unscored.

model.name: Chronological result softmax v1
model.selection_metric: 2024/25 validation log loss; 2025/26 held out from weight fitting and hyperparameter selection
limitations: Historical backtest, not a live feed or guarantee of future accuracy.
Features update after each completed match day; model weights stay fixed throughout the 2025/26 walk-forward holdout.
Community/encyclopedia sources can contain errors; licenses and revisions retained.
Some club aliases and missing pre-2021 history can affect estimates.
No shot, pressure, player-tracking or live tactical event data is invented from final scores.
